name: Article 2 – § 1 – point 4; Article 29a – 43
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (a a) in paragraph 1, the following subparagraphs are added: ‘Parent undertakings that are a financial holding undertaking as defined in Article 2(15), shall be exempted from carrying out the obligations under this Article. In case of recent acquisitions of subsidiaries that are not subject to the reporting of information referred to in the first subparagraph, the parent undertaking will benefit of a 24 months transition period before being required to integrate information on its new subsidiary, within its consolidated sustainability report.’;
